message.content:
Read the single-file browser game at /config/workspace/games/zelena-imperija/zelena-imperija.html.
It is a FarmVille-style cannabis-growing tycoon game. Design spec: /config/workspace/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-zelena-imperija-design.md.
All player-facing text is Macedonian Cyrillic; all code identifiers are Latin-transliterated
Macedonian (zasadiSemka, parichnik, presmetajKvalitet). This is deliberate — do NOT report
the Macedonian naming or the Macedonian UI as a problem, and do not suggest renaming to English.
It must stay ONE self-contained file with no external assets, no build step, no network calls —
do NOT suggest splitting it into modules, adding a bundler, or adding dependencies.
Report ONLY concrete defects you can point at in the actual code. No speculation, no style
preferences, no "consider adding tests". If you find nothing real in your lens, return an empty list.

YOUR LENS: JavaScript correctness in the browser.
Check: the tick loop and its delta-time catch-up; state mutation during iteration; stale
references after vchitaj() replaces the sostojba object; the dirty-flag panel rendering;
DOM node caching in lejaJazli versus izgradiLei being called again; inline onclick handlers
resolving against globals under "use strict"; SVG attribute vs CSS transform handling;
number formatting with toLocaleString('mk-MK'); localStorage failure paths; the save/load
round trip and field normalisation; any place a NaN or undefined can enter state; event
listener or setTimeout leaks from izvesti(); and whether iscrtajSe() can throw for any
reachable state (empty bed, locked bed, unknown strain, plant at zdravje 0, faza missing).
Report only defects with a concrete reproduction.

findings.title: vchitaj() does not validate sostojba.statistika fields from the save file, allowing NaN/garbage to enter state and permanently corrupt the HUD
findings.problem: Every other field restored by vchitaj() (parichnik, nivo, iskustvo, den, chas, brojLei, lampa, semki, sushara, magacin, pazar, nadgradbi) is explicitly checked with Number.isFinite/najdiSorta/etc. before being accepted, specifically to keep a corrupted or hand-edited save from injecting NaN into gameplay state (the code even has a comment to that effect: 'за оштетен сејв да не внесе NaN во парите'). The `statistika` object is the one exception: `Object.assign(svez.statistika, s.statistika || {})` copies every property of the saved statistika object onto the fresh one with no type or finiteness check at all.
findings.failure_scenario: Open devtools, edit the save: `let p=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('zelena-imperija-sejv')); p.s.statistika.vkupnoGrama='oops'; localStorage.setItem('zelena-imperija-sejv', JSON.stringify(p));` then reload. vchitaj() copies the string straight into sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama. `iscrtajSe()` then renders `HUD.grama.textContent = Math.round(sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama) + ' г'` → `Math.round('oops')` is `NaN`, so the HUD permanently shows 'NaN г'. Because `zavrsiSushenje()` does `sostojba.statistika.vkupnoGrama += grama`, once it is NaN it stays NaN forever (NaN + number = NaN) for the rest of the playthrough, even across further saves/loads — the 'Вкупна берба' stat is unrecoverably broken until the player resets the game.
findings.fix: Validate each statistika field the same way the rest of vchitaj() does, e.g. `statistika: { vkupnoBerbi: Number.isFinite(s.statistika?.vkupnoBerbi) ? s.statistika.vkupnoBerbi : 0, vkupnoGrama: Number.isFinite(s.statistika?.vkupnoGrama) ? s.statistika.vkupnoGrama : 0, vkupnoZaraboteno: Number.isFinite(s.statistika?.vkupnoZaraboteno) ? s.statistika.vkupnoZaraboteno : 0 }` instead of an unguarded Object.assign.
